real_sample_qualification.note: Confirmed on real zh+en Voice of America material under prompt-template v2 (Phase 11 ticket 15), which renders each cue's verbatim recognized text plus the exact output envelope. Both clips project into verified, cue-cited SemanticSegments in Chinese prose (zh: 9 finer cues -> one segment titled 江歌案的舆论引爆与法律争议, 6 cited details; en: 11 finer cues -> one segment titled 中国'皇亲国戚'的财富崛起与社会不平等, 8 cited details); the v1 prompt returned model_output_invalid (a cue-id echo) on both. Recorded observation for Phase 12: the model groups a single-topic clip into one segment; multi-segment behaviour is not yet exercised and remains to be tuned against human reference.

notes: Model-specific text-semantics decoding calibration profile (ADR 0056) for the Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-8bit engine executed through the Model runtime subprocess (ADR 0055) with mlx-lm. model_identity binds the exact pinned model asset SHA-256, the mlx-lm backend and version, the 8-bit precision, the apple-m1 device class, and the text-analysis rules fingerprint; any bound-identity change invalidates the profile. prompt_template_version binds the versioned prompt template the profile was calibrated for, so a prompt revision invalidates the profile. This profile was recalibrated for prompt-template v2 (Phase 11 ticket 15), which renders each cue's verbatim recognized text and the exact output envelope into the prompt; the ticket-10 v1 prompt carried only cue identities and produced no segmentable content. decoding fixes the deterministic sampling controls: temperature 0.0 is decoded as greedy argmax and seed makes the (already deterministic) run reproducible, max_tokens bounds the generation length, and max_kv_size bounds the KV cache so peak memory stays within the 12 GiB envelope on this device. qualification_scope is 'real_sample_confirmed': the maintainer confirmed the Chinese/English semantic quality on real Voice of America zh+en material under prompt-template v2 (Phase 11 ticket 15); the real_sample_qualification block records that confirmation and its evidence. Model-proposed boundaries and content are always validated against the revalidated cue evidence by the unchanged Text-model output projection and adjudication, so this profile never makes unproven model output authoritative.
